verses.text: Mu kwezi kugira umunani kw’umwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaje ku wavugishwa n’Imana Zakariya mwene Berekiya, Berekiya mwene Ido, rivuga riti:
“ Uhoraho yarashavuriye cane ba sogokuruza banyu.
Nuko rero, bwira abantu uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Nimungarukeko,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, ‘nanje nzobagarukako,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Ntimumere nka ba sogokuruza banyu, abo abavugishwa banje ba kera babwiye bati: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Nimuhindukire muve mu nzira zanyu mbi no mu bikorwa vyanyu bibi, ariko ntibanyumvire canke ngo banshireko n’umutima, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
None ba sogokuruza banyu ubu bari he? Mbega abavugishwa n’Imana bamaho ibihe vyose?

Mbega none amajambo yanje n’ivyo nashinze nkabishikiriza abasavyi banje navugisha ntivyashitse kuri ba sogokuruza banyu? Maze barihana bavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yadukoreye ibikwiranye n’ingeso zacu n’ibikorwa vyacu, nk’uko yari yagabiye kubitugirira.’ ”

Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kw’indwi, mu kwezi kwa Shebati, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza ku wavugishwa n’Imana Zakariya mwene Berekiya, Berekiya mwene Ido.

Mw’ijoro nabonye ivyo neretswe, maze imbere yanje hari umugabo yari yicaye kw’ifarasi ifise ibara rigomba gutukura kandi na yo yari ihagaze mu biti vyitwa mirite, ahantu h’umwonga. Inyuma yiwe hari ayandi mafarasi na yo nyene y’akagajo, ayagomba kwera hamwe n’ayera.
Ndabaza nti: “Izo farasi zisigura iki, ga Mwami wanje?” Umumarayika yariko aravugana nanje aranyishura ati: “Ndakwereka ivyo ari vyo.”
Maze wa mugabo yari ahagaze muri vya biti vyitwa mirite, aransigurira ati: “Ni abo Uhoraho arungitse kugendura isi yose.”
Maze baha icegeranyo wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari ahagaze musi y’ivyo biti bati: “Twagenduye isi yose kandi twasanze isi yose itekanye iri mu mahoro.”
Maze wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho arishura ati: “ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, uzogeza ryari kutagirira imbabazi Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, ivyo warakiye kumara iyi myaka mirongo indwi yose?”
Maze Uhoraho abwira amajambo meza kandi aremesha wa mumarayika yavugana nanje.
Nuko wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje ambwira ati: “Semerera ubu butumwa ubwire abantu bose uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ngize ipfuhe ku bwa Yerusalemu na Siyoni,
kandi ndashavuriye cane amahanga yibereye mu mutekano no mu mahoro. Nari narashavuriye gatoya abantu banje, ariko ayo mahanga yabahaye igihano kirengeje.’

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Nzohindukirira Yerusalemu mfise imbabazi, kandi aho ni ho Ingoro yanje izosubira kwubakwa. Kandi umugozi wo gupima uzosubira kugororwa i Yerusalemu,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Semerera umenyeshe abantu uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ibisagara vyanje bizosubira kwuzura bisesekare ivyiza, kandi Uhoraho azosubira kuremesha Siyoni no gutoranya Yerusalemu.’ ”
Maze ndavye hejuru, mbona imbere yanje amahembe ane.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje nti: “Ibi ni ibiki?” Anyishura ati: “Ayo mahembe aserukira amahanga ane yashwiragije Abayuda n’Abisirayeli n’ab’i Yerusalemu.”
Nuko Uhoraho anyereka abacuzi bane.

Ndabaza nti: “Abo baje gukora iki?” Aranyishura ati: “Wabonye ya mahembe ane ari yo mahanga yashwiragije Abayuda kugira ngo ntihagire uwuzokwongera kuvyura umutwe. Aba bacuzi bazanywe no gutera ubwoba ayo mahanga no guca ayo mahembe yayo yadugije ngo agwanye Abayuda no gusanzaza abantu baho.”

headings.text: Ukuburira abantu ngo bagaruke k’ Uhoraho

verses.text: Maze nunamuye amaso, mbona umugabo imbere yanje afise umugozi mu ntoke.
Ndamubaza nti: “Ugiye he?” Aranyishura ati: “Ngiye gupima Yerusalemu, ngo ndabe ubwaguke n’uburebure bwaho.”
Mu gihe wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje yari agiye, uwundi mumarayika araza barahura
maze amubwira ati: “Iruka, ubwire urya musore uti: ‘Yerusalemu kizoba igisagara kitagira inzitiro kubera igitigiri kinini c’abantu n’ibitungwa bizokibamwo.
Kandi jewe ubwanje nzohabera uruzitiro rw’umuriro ruhakikuje rwo kuhakingira,’ uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘kandi nzohabera n’ubwiza bw’imbere muri co!’ ”
“Nimuze! Nimuze! Nimuhunge muve mu gihugu co mu buraruko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “kuko nabashwiragirije mu birere bine umuyaga wo mu kirere utumberamwo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nuze, yewe Siyoni! Hunga wewe uba ku mukobwa Babiloni!”
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nyenubwiza amaze kuntuma kugwanya amahanga yabanyaze ivyanyu, kuko yavuze ko uwubakozeko aba akoze mu mbone y’ijisho ryiwe.
Sinzogenda ntabanguriye ukuboko kwanje kuyagwanya kugira ngo abo bari baragize abagurano na bo babanyage ivyabo. Nuko muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yantumye.
Shira akamo hejuru unezerwe, Mukobwa w’i Siyoni. Kuko ndiko ndaza, kandi nzoba hagati muri wewe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Amahanga menshi azokwifatanya n’ Uhoraho kuri uwo musi kandi azohinduka abantu banje. Nzoba muri mwebwe namwe muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yabantumyeko.
Uhoraho azoronka i Buyuda nk’umugabane wiwe mu gihugu cejejwe kandi azosubira gutoranya Yerusalemu.
Tekerereza imbere y’ Uhoraho , yemwe abafise umubiri mwese, kuko yikanguye ava ahera hiwe.”
Maze anyereka Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru ahagaze imbere y’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho , na Satani ahagaze i buryo bwiwe ngo amwagirize.
Uhoraho abwira Satani ati: “ Uhoraho aguhane, Satani! Uhoraho , yitoranirije Yerusalemu, aguhane! Mbega uwu muntu ntameze nk’igishirira cokowe kiva mu muriro?”
Kandi Yosuwa yari yambaye impuzu zanduye ahagaze imbere y’umumarayika.
Uwo mumarayika abwira abari bahagaze imbere yiwe ati: “Nimumwambure izo mpuzu zanduye.” Maze abwira Yosuwa ati: “Raba, ndagukuyeko icaha cawe, kandi ngira nkwambike impuzu nziza.”
Maze ndavuga nti: “Nimumwambike n’igitambara ciza mu mutwe.” Nuko baca bamwambika igitambara ciza mu mutwe, mu gihe umumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari agihagaze ngaho.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abwira Yosuwa aya majambo ati:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Niwamwumvira ukitondera ivyo yihanikirije, uzoganza Ingoro yiwe kandi azokuzeza abo mu rugo rwiwe, kandi azoguha ikibanza hagati y’aba bahagaze ngaha.’ ”
“Niwumve yewe Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru, wewe na bagenzi bawe bicara imbere yawe, mukaba ikimenyetso c’ibizoza. Ngiye kuzana umusavyi wanje, yitwa Shami.”

Raba ibuye nashize imbere ya Yosuwa! Iryo buye rifise impande indwi, kandi nzokwandika kuri iryo buye ibikwiye kwandikwako, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze; kandi nzokuraho icaha c’iri hanga ku musi umwe gusa.
“ ‘Kuri uwo musi, umwe wese muri mwebwe azotumira umubanyi wiwe ngo bicarane musi y’umuzabibu n’umusukoni wiwe,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.”
Maze umumarayika yavugana nanje aragaruka aza kumvyura, nk’uko umuntu avyurwa iyo yari asinziriye.

Arambaza ati: “Mbega ubona iki?” Ndamwishura nti: “Mbona igiterekwako amatara cose gikozwe mu nzahabu n’igikombe c’amavuta hejuru yaco, mbona n’amatara indwi ari kuri co, kandi gifise n’imiheha indwi ija kuri ayo matara.
Mbona kandi hari n’ibiti vy’imyelayo bibiri i ruhande yaco, kimwe i buryo bw’ico giterekwako amatara ikindi i bubamfu bwaco.”
Nca mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: “Ibi ni ibiki, Mwami wanje?”
Aranyishura ati: “Ibi ntuzi ivyo ari vyo?” Ndamwishura nti: “Oya Mwami wanje.”
Nuko aca ambwira ati: “Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho utumwe kubwira Zerubabeli uti: ‘Si ku bw’inkomezi canke ku bw’ubushobozi, ariko ni ku bwa Mpwemu wanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Wa musozi munini we, uri iki? Imbere ya Zerubabeli uzohinduka ikiyaya. Maze na we azozana ibuye rya nyuma rigumya imfuruka, kandi abantu na bo bazosemerera bavuga bati: ‘Mana rihezagire! Mana rihezagire!’ ”
Maze Uhoraho ampa irindi jambo ati:
“Amaboko ya Zerubabeli ni yo yashizeho urufatiro rw’uru rusengero; kandi amaboko yiwe ni yo azorusozera. Maze muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yabantumyeko.

Uri nde wewe wubahuka kugaya ibintu kuko bikiri bito biri mu ntango? Nayo arya matara indwi yerekana inyonga z’ Uhoraho zigendagenda mw’isi yose, kandi azonezerwa abonye karisho mu kuboko kwa Zerubabeli?”
Maze mbaza uwo mumarayika nti: “Ibi biti vy’imyelayo bibiri kimwe i buryo ikindi i bubamfu bw’igiterekwako amatara bisigura iki?”
Kandi ndongera ndamubaza nti: “Ayo mashami abiri ari i ruhande y’imiheha ibiri y’inzahabu ivamwo amavuta y’inzahabu ni iki?”
Aranyishura ati: “Ntuzi ivyo ari vyo?” Ndavuga nti: “Oya, Mwami wanje.”
Nuko aravuga ati: “Ivyo ni abantu babiri barobanujwe amavuta ngo bakorere Umwami w’isi yose.”
Ndasubira ndaraba, mbona imbere yanje umuzingo uguruka.
Maze wa mumarayika arambaza ati: “Ubona iki?” Ndamwishura nti: “Mbona umuzingo uguruka, ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure na cumi z’ubwaguke.”

Aca arambwira ati: “Uyu ni umuvumo ugiye mu gihugu cose; kuko nk’uko wanditseko ku ruhande rumwe, abasuma bose bazokwirukanwa bave mu gihugu, kandi nk’uko wanditseko ku rundi ruhande, abarahira ibinyoma bose bazokwirukanwa.

Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ati: ‘Nzowutuma usohoke, maze uzokwinjira mu nzu y’umusuma wese no mu nzu y’uwurahira ibinyoma wese mw’izina ryanje. Uzoguma muri iyo nzu kandi uzoyisambura yose, zaba imbaho, yaba n’amabuye ayubatse.’ ”
Nuko umumarayika yari yamye avugana nanje aranyegera aza aho ndi arambwira ati: “Rangamiza urabe kirya kintu giserutse.”
Ndamubaza nti: “Kirya ni igiki?” Aranyishura ati: “Ni igiseke.” Arongerako ati: “Ico giseke cuzuye ukugabitanya kw’abantu bo muri iki gihugu cose.”
Maze umupfundikizo waco ukozwe mu muringa ukurwaho, hanyuma mbona muri ca giseke umugore yicayemwo!
Wa mumarayika aca ambwira ati: “Uyu ni ukugabitanya,” maze aca amutsindagira muri ca giseke aca ashirako wa mupfundikizo ukozwe mu muringa.
Maze ntaramuye amaso, mbona imbere yanje abagore babiri, baguruka baza aho turi batekeye umuyaga mu mababa yabo! Bari bafise amababa nk’ay’agasoza, baca baterura ca giseke bagitwara mu kirere.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: “Mbega kirya giseke bakijanye he?”
Anyishura ati: “Bakijanye mu gihugu c’i Babiloni aho bazocubakira ingoro. Iyo ngoro niyuzura, ico giseke bazogishira aho categuriwe kigaragare cane.”
Nsubiriye kwunamura amaso, mbona imbere yanje imikogote ine isokoroka ivuye hagati y’imisozi ibiri, kandi iyo misozi yari imisozi y’umwakaka.
Umukogote wa mbere wakwegwa n’amafarasi y’akagajo, uwa kabiri wakwegwa n’ayirabura,
uwa gatatu wakwegwa n’ayera, uwa kane na wo wakwegwa n’ayafise amabara menshi, kandi yose yari afise inkomezi nyinshi.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: “Ivyo ni ibiki ga mwami wanje?”
Wa mumarayika aranyishura ati: “Izo ni impwemu zine zo mw’ijuru, zisohotse ziva aho zama zihagaze imbere y’Umwami aganza isi yose.
Urya mukogote ufise amafarasi yirabura ugiye werekeye igihugu co mu buraruko, uw’amafarasi yera werekeye mu burengero, uw’amafarasi afise amabara menshi na wo werekeye mu bumanuko.”
Igihe ayo mafarasi y’inkomezi nyinshi yasohoka, yashaka kugendagenda mw’isi yose. Maze uwo mumarayika aca avuga ati: “Nimugendagende mw’isi yose!” Nuko aca agenda kugenzura isi yose.
Maze uwo mumarayika arampamagara ati: “Raba, amwe agiye yerekeye mu gihugu co mu buraruko gusukayo uburake bwanje bituma umutima wanje uruhuka ku vy’igihugu co mu buraruko.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rirambwira riti:
“Niwakire ifeza n’inzahabu ku bari barajanywe ari inyagano ari bo Heludayi, Tobiya na Yedaya, bashitse bavuye i Babiloni. Ugende uwo musi nyene kwa Yosiya mwene Zefaniya.
Ujane za feza na za nzahabu ucure urugori maze urwambike Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, ku mutwe.
Umubwire uti uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ehe umuntu yitwa Shami araje, kandi azoshamikira mu kibanza ciwe maze yubake urusengero rw’ Uhoraho .

Ni we azokwubaka urusengero rw’ Uhoraho , azokwambikwa icubahiro c’inganji maze yicare ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami aganze. Ari ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami, azoba n’umuherezi, kandi ayo mabanga yiwe abiri azoyahuza neza mu rutonde ntangere.’
Urwo rugori ruzobwa Heludayi, Tobiya, Yedaya na Heni mwene Zefaniya nk’icibutso mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Abari kure bazoza bafashe kwubaka urusengero rw’ Uhoraho , maze muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yabantumyeko. Ivyo bizoba nimwagira umwete wo kwumvira Uhoraho Imana yanyu.”
Mu mwaka ugira kane umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaje kuri Zakariya ku musi ugira kane w’ukwezi kw’icenda, ari kwo Kisilevu.
Abantu b’i Beteli bari batumye Sharezeri na Regemu-Meleki, hamwe n’abantu babo, ngo babasigurize Uhoraho

mu kubaza abaherezi bo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose n’abavugishwa n’Imana ngo: “Tuzobandanya kuboroga no kwisonzesha mu kwezi kugira gatanu, nk’uko twagumye tubigira muri iyi myaka yose ishize, twibuka umusi urusengero rwasamburwa?”
Nuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yongera kumbwira ijambo ati:

“Baza abantu bo mu gihugu hamwe n’abaherezi uti: ‘Hamwe mwisonzesha mukaboroga mu kwezi kugira gatanu no mu kugira indwi muri iyi myaka iheze uko ari mirongo indwi, mbega harya vy’ukuri mwisonzesha ku bwanje?
Kandi igihe mwarya mukanywa, ntimwaba muriko murinezereza mwebwe ubwanyu?

Mbega aya si yo majambo Uhoraho yabamenyesheje ayacishije mu bo yavugisha ba kera igihe Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vyari bihakikije vyari mu mutekano kandi vyuzuye ubutunzi, na Negebu n’ibiyaya vyaho bikirimwo abantu?’ ”
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza kuri Zakariya riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Nimuce imanza zibereye; mugire imbabazi mubabarane.
Ntimucinyize umupfakazi n’impfuvyi, inyambukira canke umukene. Ntimugire inama yo kugirira abandi nabi.’
Ariko banka kwumva; bakomantaza imitima yabo bantera ibitugu biziba amatwi.

Imitima yabo barayikomantaza bayigira nk’ibuye ntibumvira ivyagezwe n’amajambo y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yari yabatumyeko akoresheje Mpwemu wiwe yavugisha abavugishwa biwe ba kera. Ni co catumye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose araka cane.
‘Aho nahamagara, ntibanyumvirije; ni co catumye igihe bahamagara, nanje ntabumvirije,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Nabasanzarishije agashururu mu mahanga yose, aho babaye inyambukira. Igihugu bavuyemwo casigaye ari imisaka ku buryo ata muntu yagicamwo. Uko ni ko bahinduye imisaka ico gihugu c’igikundiro.’ ”

headings.text: Imanza ziroranye no kugira imbabazi, aho kwisonzesha

verses.text: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yambariye.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Mfise ipfuhe ryinshi ku bwa Siyoni; ndahafitiye ipfuhe rirurumba muri jewe kurya kw’umuriro.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nzogaruka i Siyoni mbe muri Yerusalemu. Maze Yerusalemu hazokwitwa igisagara co kwizigirwa, kandi umusozi w’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose uzokwitwa Umusozi Wera.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Abatama n’abatamakazi bazosubira kandi kugendagenda mu mabarabara y’i Yerusalemu, umwe wese yitwaje inkoni kubera ubusaza.
Amayira y’igisagara azokwuzura abahungu n’abakobwa bakiniraho.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Naho ivyo womenga biratangaje ku masigarira y’aba bantu muri iki gihe, mbega no kuri jewe vyoba ibitangaje?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nzokiza abantu banje ndabakure mu bihugu vyo mu buseruko n’ivyo mu burengero.
Nzobagarukana ngo babe i Yerusalemu; bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba umwizigirwa n’umugororotsi kuko ndi Imana yabo.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “None rero nimwumve aya majambo: amaboko yanyu nakomere, mwubake urusengero. Ibi ni vyo nyene abavugishwa n’Imana bavuze igihe itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ryashirwaho.

Imbere y’aho nta muntu yatanga impembo y’umukozi yo ku musi canke ngo akoteshe inka. Nta n’umwe yaja ku bikorwa vyiwe ngo agaruke amahoro kubera abansi, kandi kuko nari nahinduye umwe wese ngo abe umwansi wa mugenziwe.
Ariko ubu nzogirira amasigarira y’ubu bwoko nk’uko nabagirira kera,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Imbuto zizokura neza, umuzabibu uzokwama ivyamwa vyawo, isi izotuma haba ivyimburwa, n’amajuru azozana ikime cayo. Ivyo vyose nzobiha amasigarira y’aba bantu ngo bibe umwandu wabo.
Nk’uko mwebwe, Abayuda n’Abisirayeli, mwabaye umuvumo mu mahanga, ni ko nzobakiza, kandi muzoba umugisha. Ntimutinye, ahubwo amaboko yanyu nakomere.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ati: “Nk’uko nafashe ingingo yo kubateza ivyago no kutabagirira akagongwe igihe ba sogokuruza banyu bandatsa,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze,
“ni ko n’ubu mfashe ingingo yo gusubira kugirira neza Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda. Ntimutinye.
Ibi ni vyo mukwiye gukora: muvugane ukuri na bagenzi banyu, kandi muce imanza z’ukuri kandi zibereye mu bucamanza bwanyu;
ntimugire inama zo kugirira bagenzi banyu nabi, kandi ntimukunde kurahira ibinyoma. Ivyo ndavyanka,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose rinzako.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Ukwisonzesha no kugandara vyo mu kwezi kugira kane n’ukugira gatanu n’ukw’indwi n’ukw’icumi, ubu birarangiye, bihindutse imisi mikuru y’umunezero ku Bayuda. Nuko rero mukunde ukuri n’amahoro.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Amoko menshi n’ababa mu bisagara vyinshi bazoza,
ababa mu gisagara kimwe bazoja mu kindi babwirane bati: ‘Ingo tujane gutazira no kwambaza Uhoraho Mushoboravyose. Jewe ubwanje ndagiye.’
Kandi amoko menshi n’amahanga ahambaye azoza i Yerusalemu kurondera Uhoraho Mushoboravyose kugira ngo amusabe umuhezagiro.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Muri iyo misi abantu cumi bo mu ndimi zose n’amahanga bazofata Umuyuda umwe ku buyonga bw’impuzu yiwe bavuge bati: Reka tujane nawe, kuko twumvise ko Imana iri kumwe namwe.”

Ivyavugishijwe Zakariya: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryarumvikanye ryo kwagiriza igihugu ca Haduraki kandi rizoza kuruhukira kuri Damasiko, kuko inyonga z’ Uhoraho ziri ku bantu bose hamwe n’imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli,
ziri no kuri Hamati na ho nyene, ahahana urubibe na ho, no kuri Tiro n’i Sidoni, naho bazi ubwenge bwinshi.
Tiro hiyubakiye uruzitiro; hirundaniriza ifeza nk’umukungugu, n’inzahabu nk’umwavu wo mu mabarabara.
Ariko Imana izojana ubutunzi bwaho bwose kandi izosenyurira inkomezi zaho mu kiyaga, kandi hazotongozwa umuriro.

Igisagara Ashikeloni kizobibona gitinye; i Gaza bazohinda agashitsi kubera ubwoba, na Ekuroni na ho nyene, kuko ivyizigiro vyaho bizoba biheze. Gaza hazobura umwami waho kandi Ashikeloni na ho hazosigara ari ubugaragwa.
Abantu b’ibivyarwa ni bo bazokwibera muri Ashidodi, kandi nzomara ubwibone Abafilisitiya.

Nzokura inyama zikirimwo amaraso mu minwa yabo, nkure n’ivyokurya baterekereye ibigirwamana mu menyo yabo. Abasigaye bazoba inyegu y’Imana yacu kandi bazohinduka umuryango umwe wa Yuda, kandi n’abo muri Ekuroni bazohinduka nk’Abayebusi.
Ariko jewe nzoshira ikirindiro canje ku rusengero rwanje ngo ndarurinde ingabo zoza kurutera. Nta wucinyiza azosubira guca mu bantu banje, kuko ndaharinze.

Nezerwa cane Mukobwa w’i Siyoni! Ushire ijwi ryawe hejuru, Mukobwa w’i Yerusalemu! Raba, umwami wawe arakugendeye, ni umugororotsi kandi afise intsinzi, yicishije bugufi kandi agendera ku ndogoba, mbere aje ku nyana yayo.

Nzokuraho imikogote muri Efurayimu n’amafarasi y’intambara ndayakure muri Yerusalemu, nzovunagura n’imiheto yo ku rugamba. Azovuga ivy’amahoro mu mahanga. Ukuganza kwiwe kuzova ku kiyaga gushike ku kindi no kuva ku ruzi Efurate gushika ku mpera z’isi.
Ariko mweho, kubera amaraso yanje y’isezerano dufitaniye, nzobarekurira imbohe zanyu ndazikure mu rwobo rutagira amazi.
Nimugaruke mu kibanza muzigamirwamwo, yemwe mbohe ziri n’ivyizigiro; mbere n’ubu ndabamenyesheje ko nzobashumbusha incuro zibiri imibabaro.
Nzogonda i Buyuda nk’uko bagonda umuheto maze Efurayimu ndabahindure nk’umwampi. Nzokabura abahungu bawe, ewe Siyoni, ngo batere abahungu bawe, ewe Bugiriki, nzobagira nk’inkota y’umuhizi.
Maze Uhoraho azoseruka hejuru y’abantu biwe; umwampi wiwe uzorabagirana nk’umuravyo. Uhoraho Nyeninganji azovuza inzamba; azogendera mu bihuhusi nk’ivy’umuyaga wo mu bumanuko,

kandi Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azobabera inkinzo ibakingira. Bazosangangura bongere batsinde abansi babo bakoresheje amabuye atereshwa umugozi. Bazokwiha akamo mu ntambara nk’ababorewe umuvinyu; bazoba buzuye amaraso nk’uko igikombe gikoreshwa mu gucucagira imfuruka z’igicaniro.
Uhoraho Imana yabo azotabara abantu biwe kuri uwo musi nk’uko umwungere atabara imikuku yiwe. Bazokayangana mu gihugu ciwe nk’amabuye y’igiciro ari ku rugori.
Ese ukugene bazoba ari beza kandi bateye igomwe! Ingano zizotuma abasore bakura, kandi n’umutobe ni ko uzobera abakobwa.
Nimusabe Uhoraho imvura mu gihe c’impeshi; Uhoraho ni we aganza ibicu n’imituragaro. Atanga imvura y’umuvuvu ku bantu bose, akameza ibiterwa bitotahaye mu mirima y’umuntu wese.

Ibigirwamana bivuga ibinyoma, abahamagara imizimu berekwa ibinyoma. Barotora inzozi z’ibinyoma, bakaremesha abantu mu vy’ubusabusa. Ni co gituma abantu basanzara hirya no hino nk’intama zihahazwa kubera kubura umwungere.
“Uburake bwanje buri ku bungere, kandi nzohana abo batware; kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azokwitwararika umukuku wiwe, ari bo bantu b’i Buyuda, abahindure nk’ifarasi y’ubwibone mu ntambara.
Muri Yuda hazovamwo ibuye rigumya imfuruka, muri we hazovamwo urumambo rugumya ihema, muri we hazovamwo umuheto w’intambara, muri we hazovamwo abatware bose.
Bose hamwe bazoba nk’abahizi mu ntambara basiribangira umwansi wabo mu vyondo vyo mu mabarabara. Bazogwana kuko Uhoraho ari kumwe na bo, kandi bazotuma abansi babo bagwanira ku mafarasi bamaramara.
Nzoha inkomezi Yuda kandi nzotabara imiryango ya Yosefu. Nzobagarukana kuko ndabagirira impuhwe. Nzomera nk’aho ntigeze ndabaheba, kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo kandi nzobishura amasengesho yabo.
Abefurayimu bazoba nk’abahizi, kandi imitima yabo izonezerwa nk’ababorewe umuvinyu. Abana babo bazobibona bahimbarwe; imitima yabo izonezererwa Uhoraho .
Nzobahamagara ndabegeranye. Vy’ukuri nzobacungura; bazoba benshi bagwire nka kera.
Naho nabasanzarije mu mahanga menshi, bazonyibuka bari mu bihugu vya kure. Kandi bo n’abana babo bazobaho, kandi bazogaruka.
Nzobagarukana ndabakure muri Egiputa ndabegeranye ndabakuye muri Ashuri. Nzobazana i Gileyadi n’i Libani, kandi ntibazoronka aho bakwirwa.
Bazoca mu kiyaga c’amarushwa; nzotururuza imipfunda yo mu kiyaga n’i bwina h’uruzi Nili hazokwuma. Ubwibone bwa Ashuri buzotururuzwa n’icumu ry’ubugabe rya Egiputa rizokurwaho.
Nzobaha inkomezi zivuye k’ Uhoraho kandi mw’izina ryiwe bazobaho mu mutekano,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ugurura amarembo yawe, ewe Libani, kugira ngo umuriro utongore amasederi yawe!
Nimuboroge, yemwe biti vy’ubujwari, kubera amasederi yiciwe; ibiti biteye igomwe vyaguye hasi! Nimuboroge, yemwe biti binini cane vy’i Bashani; kuko ishamba ryari rizitanye ryatemwe!
Umviriza ukuboroga kw’abungere; kuko uburagiro butotahaye bwabo bwakuweho! Umviriza ukuroha kw’intambwe; kuko ubwihisho bwazo bwo kuri Yorodani bwakuweho.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana yanje avuze: “Ragira umukuku wagerewe gukererwa.
Abaziguze barazikerera bakigira badahanywe. Abazigurishije na bo bakavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho ahimbazwe, turi abatunzi!’ N’abungere bazo ubwabo ntibaruha bazigirira akagongwe.

Ni nk’uko nyene, sinzosubira kugirira akagongwe abantu b’iki gihugu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Nzotanga umuntu wese mu maboko y’abagenzi biwe n’umwami wabo. Bazotabagura igihugu, kandi sinzotabara n’umwe ngo ndamubakure mu maboko.”
Nuko nca ndagira wa mukuku wagerewe kubagwa, canecane izihahazwa zo mu mukuku. Maze nca nakira inkoni zibiri, imwe ndayita Buntu iyindi Bumwe, maze nca ngenda kuragira wa mukuku.
Mu kwezi kumwe nca nirukana abungere bawo batatu. Wa mukuku uca uranyanka, nanje ndushaho kugenda ndawurambirwa
maze ndavuga nti: “Sinzoba umwungere wanyu. Reka iyiriko irapfa ipfe, iyo kwicwa na yo yicwe. Izisigaye na zo ziryane zihezanye ubwazo.”
Nuko mfata ya nkoni yitwa Buntu ndayivunamwo kubiri, kugira ngo nerekane ko nkuyeho isezerano nasezeranye n’amahanga yose.
Rica rikurwaho kuri uwo musi nyene, maze izacinyijwe zo mu mukuku zariko zirandaba zica zimenya ko ari ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Ndazibwira nti: “Nimba bibabereye vyiza, nimumpe impembo yanje; ariko bitari uko, nimuyigumye.” Nuko bampemba ibiceri vy’ifeza mirongo itatu.
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Yaterere umubumvyi,” ico giciro ciza babonye ko nkwiye! Nuko nca mfata vya biceri vy’ifeza mirongo itatu ndabiterera umubumvyi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Ndaheza mvuna ya nkoni igira kabiri yitwa Bumwe, mba mvunye ubumwe hagati ya Yuda na Isirayeli.
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Subira wakire ibikoresho vya wa mwungere w’igipfu.

Kuko ngiye guhagurutsa umwungere w’iki gihugu atazobabara izazimiye, canke ngo arondere imyagazi, canke ngo avure izakomeretse, canke ngo agaburire izikomeye. Ahubwo azorya inyama z’intama z’indobanurwa, kugeza no ku binono.
Aragowe uwo mwungere w’igipfu ata co amaze, uwo ata umukuku! Aragakubitwa inkota ku kuboko no ku jisho ry’i buryo! Ukuboko kwiwe nikunyunyuke rwose, ijisho ryiwe ry’i buryo na ryo rihume rwose!”
Ivyavugishijwe Zakariya: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryerekeye Abisirayeli. Uhoraho , ni we yashanje amajuru, ashiraho urufatiro rw’isi, kandi ni we arema agashira impwemu mu muntu, avuze ati:
“Ngiye guhindura Yerusalemu kuba igikombe kiboreza amahanga yose ahakikuje. I Buyuda hazokwugarizwa hamwe n’i Yerusalemu.
Kuri uwo musi, aho amahanga yose yo kw’isi azoba yakoraniye kuhagwanya, nzohindura Yerusalemu igitandara kitanyiganyizwa ku mahanga yose. Abazogerageza kukinyiganyiza ni bo bazokomereka.
Kuri uwo musi nzoteza ifarasi yose ubwoba, uwuyigenderako na we ndamuteze ibisazi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Nzogumiza ijisho ryanje kuri Yuda, ariko nzoteza uruhumyi amafarasi yose y’amahanga.
Maze abakuru b’imiryango ya Yuda bazovuga mu mitima yabo bati: ‘Abantu b’i Yerusalemu ni abanyenkomezi, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari Imana yabo.’

Kuri uwo musi nzohindura imiryango ya Yuda imere nk’umuriro mu kirundo c’inkwi, canke nk’igishirira kiri mu miganda y’ingano. Bazotongora amahanga abakikije i buryo n’i bubamfu, ariko Yerusalemu ho hazoguma hahangamye mu kibanza caho.”
Uhoraho azotabara amazu y’Abayuda ubwa mbere, kugira ngo icubahiro c’inzu ya Dawidi n’ic’ababa i Yerusalemu ntikirute ica Yuda.

Kuri uwo musi Uhoraho azokingira ababa i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo umunyantegenke wo muri bo aze abe nka Dawidi, n’uruvyaro rwa Dawidi ruze rube nk’Imana, canke nk’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho agiye imbere yabo.
Kuri uwo musi nzosohokanwa no gusangangura amahanga yose azotera Yerusalemu.
Nzosuka ku nzu ya Dawidi no ku baba i Yerusalemu impwemu y’ubuntu no gusenga. Bazondaba, jewe uwo bacumise, maze baboroge nk’uwuborogera umwana wiwe w’ikinege, bagandare nk’uwugandarira imfura yiwe.
Kuri uwo musi gucura intimba muri Yerusalemu kuzoba kwinshi nka kwa gucura intimba ku bwa Hadadi-Rimoni mu kiyaya c’i Megido.
Igihugu kizoboroga, umuryango wose ukwawo, hamwe n’abagore babo ukwabo: umuryango w’inzu ya Dawidi n’abagore babo, umuryango w’inzu ya Natani n’abagore babo,
umuryango w’inzu ya Lewi n’abagore babo, umuryango wa Shimeyi n’abagore babo,
n’abasigaye bose bo mu miryango n’abagore babo.
“Kuri uwo musi iriba rizotoborerwa abo mu nzu ya Dawidi n’ababa i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo ruboze icaha n’ubuhumane.
Kuri uwo musi, nzozimanganya abasenga ibigirwamana mu gihugu, ku buryo n’amazina yavyo atazosubira kwibukwa,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Nzokuraho ba kamenyi n’impwemu ihumanya mu gihugu.

Kandi nihagira n’umuntu n’umwe yongera kuvugishwa, se na nyina bamwivyariye, bazomubwira bati: ‘Ntugenda udapfuye, kuko wavuze ibinyoma mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .’ Maze abavyeyi biwe bwite ni bo bazomusogota.
Kuri uwo musi umuntu wese avugishwa azogira isoni zo kuvuga ko yeretswe. Kandi ntibazosubira kwambara impuzu zibaranga nk’abavugishwa kugira ngo babeshe abantu.
Umwe wese azovuga ati: ‘Sindi umuvugishwa. Ndi umurimyi; mbeshejweho n’ukurima isi kuva mu buto bwanje.’
Nihagira uwubabaza ati: ‘Ivyo bikomere ku mubiri wawe vyavuye kuki?’ bazomwishura bati: ‘Ni ivyo nakomerekeye mu nzu y’abagenzi banje.’

Vyuka, yewe wa nkota, ukubite umwungere wanje, ukubite urya muntu ari hafi yanje,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Kubita umwungere, intama zisanzare, nanje nzohindukiriza ukuboko kwanje kugwanya imyagazi.
Mu gihugu cose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, babiri kuri batatu bazokwicwa; umwe muri batatu ni we azosigara.

Abo bazoba basigaye, ni bo nzocisha mu muriro; nzobamara inkamba nk’ifeza ndabagerageze nk’inzahabu. Bazokwambaza izina ryanje nanje nzobishura; nzovuga nti: ‘Ni abantu banje,’ na bo bazovuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu.’ ”
Umusi w’ Uhoraho uraje, ewe Yerusalemu, aho ubutunzi bwawe buzosahurwa bukagabanganirizwa hagati mu nzitiro zawe.

Nzokoraniriza amahanga yose i Yerusalemu ngo bahagwanye; ico gisagara kizofatwa mpiri, amazu asahurwe, n’abagore bafatwe ku nguvu. Igice c’igisagara kizojanwa ari inyagano, ariko abasigaye ntibazokurwa mu gisagara.
Maze Uhoraho azosohokanwa no kugwanya ayo mahanga, nk’uko agwana ku musi w’intambara.

Kuri uwo musi ibirenge vyiwe bizohagarara ku Musozi wa Elayono, uri mu buseruko bw’i Yerusalemu, maze Umusozi wa Elayono uzosadukamwo kubiri uhereye mu buseruko ukageza mu burengero, haboneke ikiyaya kinini, igice kimwe c’uwo musozi cimuke kija mu buraruko ikindi mu bumanuko.

Muzohungira muri ico kiyaya canje c’uwo musozi, kuko kizoshika muri Azeli. Muzohunga nk’uko mwahunze nyamugigima mu misi ya Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda. Maze Uhoraho Imana yanje azoza, ari kumwe n’abejejwe bose.
Kuri uwo musi izuba ntirizokwaka canke ngo habe gukanya, canke umwijima.
Uzoba ari umusi wisa, umusi uzwi n’ Uhoraho wenyene, ata gutandukanya umurango n’ijoro. No mu gihe c’umugoroba umuco uzogumaho.
Kuri uwo musi amazi y’ubugingo azotemba ava i Yerusalemu, igice kimwe kizoja mu buseruko mu Kiyaga c’Umunyu ikindi gice kije mu burengero mu Kiyaga Mediterane, mu ci no mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi.
Uhoraho azoba umwami w’isi yose. Kuri uwo musi hazoba Uhoraho umwe, kandi izina ryiwe rizoba rimwe rudende.

Igihugu cose, uhereye i Geba ugashika i Rimoni, mu bumanuko bwa Yerusalemu, kizoba nka Araba. Ariko Yerusalemu hazoshirwa hejuru cane uhereye kw’Irembo rya Benyamini ukageza mu kibanza c’Irembo rya Mbere, ukabandanya ukageza kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, ugakomeza ukava ku munara wa Hananeli ukageza ku bwato bwo kuganiramwo umuvinyu bw’i bwami. Kandi hazoguma mu kibanza caho.
Abantu bazohaba; kandi ntihazokwongera gusamburwa. Yerusalemu hazoba umutekano.
Iki ni co cago Uhoraho azoteza amahanga yose azotera i Yerusalemu: inyama zabo zizobora bakigendagenda, amaso yabo aborere mu bibanza vyayo, n’indimi zabo zizoborera mu kanwa kabo.
Kuri uwo musi abantu bazoterwa ubwoba n’ Uhoraho . Bazosubiranamwo bagwane.
Yuda na we azogwanira i Yerusalemu. Ubutunzi bw’ibihugu bihakikije buzokwegeranywa; inzahabu n’ifeza vyinshi cane n’impuzu.
Icago nk’ico kizoshika ku mafarasi n’inyumbu, ingamiya n’indogoba, n’ibindi bitungano bizoba muri ayo makambi.
Maze abazocika kw’icumu bo mu mahanga yose yateye Yerusalemu bazoduga uko umwaka utashe gusenga Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, no guhimbaza imisi mikuru y’insago.
Kandi nihagira umuntu n’umwe wo muri ayo moko yo kw’isi atazoduga i Yerusalemu gusenga Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ntazoronka imvura.
Abanyegiputa nibataduga ngo bifatanye n’abandi, nta mvura bazoronka. Uhoraho azobarekurirako icago azoteza amahanga ataza guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago.
Ico kizoba ari igihano kuri Egiputa n’igihano ku mahanga yose atazoduga guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago.
Kuri uwo musi amajambo “Yerejwe Uhoraho ” azokwandikwa ku mijiginya y’amafarasi, n’inkono zo gutekamwo zo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho zizoba nk’ibikoresho vy’imbere y’igicaniro.

Inkono zose z’i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda zizoba zerejwe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, kandi abazoza gushikana ibimazi bazokwakira zimwe muri izo nkono bazitekemwo. Kandi kuri uwo musi ntihazoba Umunyakanani mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
